title: L-O-V-E VERSION 2
lyrics_plain:
L is for the way you look at me
O is for the only one I see
V is very, very extra ordinary
E is even more anyone that you adore
Love is all that I can give to you
Love is more than just a game for two
Two in love can make it take my heart
And please don't break it
Love was made for me and you.
L is for the way you look at me
O is for the only one I see

E is even more anyone that you adore
Love is all that I can give to you

And please don't break it
Love was made for me and you.
Dedicated to my Glem,Eunice,Glecy and Michael;
and of course to all of you out there now and
in the future world who listens to this midikaraoke
I coded:Daddy Manny (maharlika@att.net) Let's thank
also the one who made this beautiful sequencing:
someone by the name of MR. HARRY TODD
